intro: {{nameA}} and {{nameB}} are private engineering campuses in {{cityA}}, Punjab, and they belong to the same wider college group. This page compares recorded {{course}} fees, placements and ranks from our database and official sites opened in {{year}}.
CGC Jhanjeri vs CGC Landran is a two-campus choice, not a choice between unrelated brands. The short title repeats the group name; use the campus names in the table when you read fees and placements.

sections.heading: CGC Jhanjeri vs CGC Landran for B.Tech / B.E.: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose CGC Landran if you want the campus with a 2023 B.Tech Computer Science record of ₹16 lakh average and ₹55 lakh highest, and recorded CSE year totals around ₹1.33 lakh to ₹1.35 lakh.

Choose CGC Jhanjeri if you prefer that campus and its recorded CSE year totals around ₹1.28 lakh to ₹1.30 lakh, after you accept that our only Jhanjeri B.Tech placement row is from 2018 and is too old to treat as current.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show, and what to watch
paragraphs: For CGC Jhanjeri we hold Total Fees year figures of ₹1,30,300 and ₹1,28,300 for B.Tech Computer Science, with nearby amounts for civil, ECE and other branches, and slightly higher year figures for some AI and data-science rows.

For CGC Landran we hold Total Fees year figures of ₹1,35,300 and ₹1,33,300 for B.Tech Computer Science and several allied programmes. These are year amounts, not a confirmed four-year official total, and we have not multiplied them.
The recorded year fees sit close to each other. Confirm the current branch-wise notice on cgc.ac.in and cgc.edu.in before you treat either figure as the full programme cost.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: CGC Landran has a 2023 B.Tech Computer Science row of ₹16 lakh average and ₹55 lakh highest, plus a 2021 highest of ₹36 lakh. Those are historical records, not a promise for your batch.

CGC Jhanjeri's only B.Tech Computer Science placement row is from 2018, with ₹7 lakh average and ₹32 lakh highest. Because it is before 2020, our summary table does not treat it as a current flagship figure.
If you need a like-for-like 2024 or 2025 comparison, ask both placement cells for the latest official report rather than stretching the 2018 Jhanjeri row.

sections.heading: Admission, ranks and eligibility
paragraphs: Both campuses are listed with JEE Main on this page. Confirm the current counselling route, including any Punjab state process, on the official admissions pages.
Our records list a NIRF 2025 Engineering entry of 201 for CGC Jhanjeri. NIRF publishes rank bands after 100, so treat 201 as a band-style listing unless you confirm the exact line on nirfindia.org.
CGC Landran's latest NIRF Engineering row here is 2021, at 147, plus India Today ranks in 2023 and 2024. Confirm the current official list before you treat either rank as settled.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: Both campuses are in Mohali, Punjab, so the city is the same; the daily commute still depends on which side of the district you live in.
They are separate campuses of the same wider group. Visit the branch labs and hostels you would actually use, rather than assuming the two sites feel identical.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: Pick CGC Landran if the 2023 CSE placement record of ₹16 lakh average and ₹55 lakh highest is central, and the slightly higher recorded year fee is acceptable.
Pick CGC Jhanjeri if that campus and branch list fit you better, and you have a recent official placement letter, because our 2018 row is not a current comparison.
Fees are close on our records. Let branch, campus visit and a fresh placement report decide, not a small year-fee gap.

faqs.question: Are CGC Jhanjeri and CGC Landran the same college?
faqs.answer: They belong to the same wider group but are separate campuses in Mohali. Compare branch, fees and the latest placement report for the campus you would actually join.

faqs.question: What B.Tech fees are on record for the two campuses?
faqs.answer: CGC Jhanjeri has CSE year totals of ₹1,30,300 and ₹1,28,300. CGC Landran has CSE year totals of ₹1,35,300 and ₹1,33,300. These are year figures, not confirmed four-year official totals.

faqs.question: Which campus has the more recent engineering placements?
faqs.answer: CGC Landran has a 2023 CSE row of ₹16 lakh average and ₹55 lakh highest. CGC Jhanjeri's CSE row is from 2018 and is too old to treat as a current flagship figure.

faqs.question: What NIRF ranks are listed here?
faqs.answer: CGC Jhanjeri has a NIRF 2025 Engineering entry listed as 201, which may reflect a rank band. CGC Landran's latest NIRF Engineering row on this page is 2021, at 147. Confirm the current list on nirfindia.org.

faqs.question: Which exam do these B.Tech programmes use?
faqs.answer: Both campuses are listed with JEE Main. Check the official admissions page for counselling and any Punjab state route.

faqs.question: Are both campuses in Mohali?
faqs.answer: Yes. Both CGC Jhanjeri and CGC Landran are recorded in Mohali, Punjab.
